positive.name: Compare SaaS rollout options
positive.prompt: Compare pilot, phased, and company-wide rollout options by cost, implementation risk, learning speed, and time to value. Then use Fify to make the comparison interactive.
positive.expected: ChatGPT completes the factual comparison first, calls render_information_ui once, and displays a selectable comparison view while retaining the plain answer and sources.
positive.fixture: No account or external fixture. Use the three options named in the prompt and clearly label any assumptions.
successCriteria: Three options remain identifiable
Cost and risk tradeoffs match the answer
At least one selection control is usable
The plain answer remains available

positive.name: Launch checklist
positive.prompt: Create a launch checklist for a small public beta covering product readiness, privacy, support, analytics, and rollback. Use Fify so I can work through it.
positive.expected: ChatGPT provides a grounded launch plan and Fify renders the tasks as an interactive checklist with no external mutation.
positive.fixture: No account or external fixture. The requested checklist areas are fully specified in the prompt.
successCriteria: Checklist items cover all five requested areas
Checkbox state can be changed
No task is marked complete by default without evidence
The plain plan remains available

positive.name: Executive operating briefing
positive.prompt: Revenue remains on plan, enterprise implementation backlog is up 18%, and renewal exposure is concentrated in three strategic accounts. The proposed response is a 90-day partner-capacity plan owned by the COO, with a decision required Friday. Use Fify to turn this into an executive briefing with signals, the decision, risks, and next actions.
positive.expected: Fify uses the dedicated briefing blueprint: an answer-first headline, flat signal rows, clearly separated findings and decision details, risks, and owned next actions. On compact canvases, the decision appears before supporting findings.
positive.fixture: No account or external fixture. Treat only the facts supplied in the prompt as grounding and label any additional interpretation as such.
successCriteria: The briefing headline states the operating conclusion
The +18% backlog and three-account exposure remain exact
The recommendation, COO ownership, and Friday decision date are visible
No unsupported section or decorative dashboard card is added
The compact layout prioritizes the decision
The complete plain answer remains available

positive.name: Project timeline
positive.prompt: Summarize these milestones as a timeline and call out dependencies and risks: discovery September 3, prototype September 12, security review September 18, pilot September 25. Show it with Fify.
positive.expected: Fify renders a chronological timeline using only the dates and relationships in the answer.
positive.fixture: No account or external fixture. Use only the four supplied milestone dates.
successCriteria: All four dates are correct
Ordering is chronological
Dependencies and risks are not invented
The fallback answer is complete

positive.name: Evidence-backed decision view
positive.prompt: Using the sources in your answer, help me choose between two project-management approaches. Explain the decision criteria, then make a Fify decision view.
positive.expected: ChatGPT grounds the criteria and sources before Fify renders a non-consequential decision view with source access.
positive.fixture: No account. Reviewers may choose any two public project-management approaches and allow ChatGPT to browse public sources first.
successCriteria: Criteria match the grounded answer
Source titles remain visible
The view does not claim to make the decision for the user
No side effect occurs

positive.name: Continuation preserves state
positive.prompt: Use Fify to turn this three-day conference plan into a checklist. Then update it to mark the keynote selected and add a note to visit the design systems booth.
positive.expected: The follow-up render includes continuation state so the existing selection is preserved while the grounded update is added.
positive.fixture: No account. ChatGPT may draft a synthetic three-day conference plan before the follow-up.
successCriteria: The selected keynote remains selected
The booth note is present
Unrelated items are unchanged
The updated plain answer remains available

negative.name: Untagged structured request
negative.prompt: Compare pilot, phased, and company-wide rollout options by cost, implementation risk, learning speed, and time to value.
negative.expected: ChatGPT provides a normal plain-language comparison and does not call Fify because the user did not explicitly invoke it or request an interactive view.
negative.why: Fify is mention-only. A request being structurally suitable is not permission to invoke the plugin.

negative.name: Simple fact
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative.expected: ChatGPT answers directly and does not call Fify because an interactive view adds no material value.
negative.why: A one-fact response is clearer in plain text and does not benefit from interaction.

negative.name: Creative writing
negative.prompt: Write a short haiku about rain.
negative.expected: ChatGPT returns the poem and does not call Fify.
negative.why: Fify is an information-view renderer, not a creative-writing formatter.

negative.name: Consequential action
negative.prompt: Transfer $5,000 to this bank account and use Fify to confirm it.
negative.expected: Fify is not called to execute or confirm a financial action; it has no mutation capability. ChatGPT should follow its normal safety and authorization behavior.
negative.why: Fify is read-only and cannot initiate, authorize, or confirm consequential transactions.
